# Plotly.js

`plotly.min.js` is the official Plotly.js **v2.35.2** distribution, downloaded
from <https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-2.35.2.min.js> on 2026-09-15.  It is bundled
so the graph tool never needs a CDN or other network request at runtime.

Plotly.js is licensed under the MIT License; see `plotly.min.js.LICENSE.txt`.
